title: L1 deep-read, verbatim core of PR section 3.2.5 captured from the PDF (pdftotext of arXiv:1706.04593v3; the entry is the durable record): the combined bound A*_{M,N1,N2} << T^eps/(dA)[ A(W^{1/2}U^{1/2}V^{5/4} + UV^{3/4}) + (sum_J B^bA^aU^uV^v)^{1/4} ] with the 1/(dA) prefactor, the Type I inner step where Blomer-Pascadi plugs exactly (a x f1 bilinear at modulus v via min(trivial, Weil) geometric mean), the seven monomials J verbatim, W' = U^{1/4} for Conrey, Hd/D/A definitions captured (A << d^2 T^{1-eps}; block constraint N1 N2 <= T^{1+o(1)}), plus first-pass boundary arithmetic: my reconstruction's binding leg is Type I term 1 with true threshold theta < 3/5, while the stated 4/7 is exactly the threshold of the quoted clean error form - the discriminator is the page-level re-derivation of the Type I 'summing over a, v, e' step and the exact Hd/A fractions (the (n,v) survival question); NO RH CLAIM
facts: VERBATIM CORE (arXiv:1706.04593v3 PDF via pdftotext, pages 17-19, section 3.2.5): (i) B1 = sum_{0<|a|<A} nu(a) sum_{u ~ U, (u,dv)=1} mu^2(u)(mu * Lambda^*s)(u) F_{dU}(du)(log u)^j / u^{alpha+w} sum_{v ~ V} r(v) e(-a u^/v), with U = N1/d, V = N2/d; (ii) Heath-Brown K = 2 decomposition: (mu * Lambda^*s)(u) = O(U^eps) linear combination of Type I (beta * g, beta on << W, g in {1, log}) and Type II (gamma * delta, W << n << U/W) pieces; Conrey: same on mu with W' = U^{1/4}; (iii) TYPE I derivation: (log f)^ell separated by binomial; after summation by parts the f-sum reduces over an interval I; inclusion-exclusion over h << F, (h,dev)=1 with mu(h); the inner sum sum_{f1 ~ F/h^2, (f1,dev)=1} mu^2(f1) e(-n f1/v) bounded by min(trivial F/h^2, Weil T^eps v^{1/2}(n,v)(1 + F v^{-1})), 'Taking the minimum of these two bounds and using the inequality min(x,y) <= (xy)^{1/2}' gives F^{1/2} v^{1/4}(1 + F^{1/2} v^{-1/2})(n,v)^{1/2} T^eps; then - VERBATIM - 'On summing over a, v, and e we obtain that the contribution to B1 from a Type I sum is << (1+|w|) T^eps A (W^{1/2} U^{1/2} V^{5/4} + U V^{3/4})'; Conrey variant: 'the summation variable is not weighted by a factor mu^2(f). We are therefore able to apply Weil's bound for Kloosterman sums directly' (same final shape, no (n,v) factor stated); (iv) TYPE II: sum_{v ~ V} r(v) sum_{a <= A} nu(a) sum_{b ~ B, (b,v)=1} gamma(b) sum_{c ~ C, (c,bv)=1} delta(c) e(abc/v), BC ~ U, W << B,C << U/W, B <= U^{1/2} WLOG; (b,c)=1 removed by Mobius 'at no cost'; DI Lemma 2.1 -> T^eps(sum_J B^b A^a U^u V^v)^{1/4}, J = {(-2,2,4,4),(-1,4,3,4),(1,4,3,3),(1,2,3,4),(3,2,3,3),(0,4,4,2),(1,3,4,2)} - components are (B,A,U,V) powers, VERBATIM; (v) COMBINED, VERBATIM: 'Combining our bounds and integrating over x, y, w, we find that A*_{M,N1,N2} << T^eps/(dA) [ A W^{1/2} U^{1/2} V^{5/4} + A U V^{3/4} + (sum_J)^{1/4} ]' - the prefactor is ONE OVER dA (the dA reading in earlier summaries was wrong); (vi) FINAL, VERBATIM (page 19): 'We set W = U^{1/6} and recall that W << B << U^{1/2}, U = N1/d, V = N2/d. Summing over dyadic intervals M << T^{O(1)}, Ni <= N, and d <= N, we find that the contribution to A from 0 < |h| <= Hd is bounded by << T^eps (N^{11/6} + N^{11/12} T^{1/2}). If N = T^theta this error is << T^{1-eps} for theta < 6/11. For Conrey's mollifier one finds that the error term is << T^eps (N^{7/4} + T^{1/2} N^{7/8}), which is sufficiently small provided N = T^theta with theta < 4/7.' (Conrey section 4 is 'a very similar analysis to that of section 3.2.5'.)

EXACT DEFINITIONS CAPTURED (pages 13-14 via pdftotext on the full PDF): 'This means that we can truncate the sum over m1, m2 to m1 m2 <= T^{1+eps}' - the TRUE block constraint is N1 N2 <= T^{1+o(1)} with M only bounded by M <= T^{1+eps} and N1, N2 <= N (the first-pass 'M <= T^{1/2}/sqrt(N1 N2)' was an inference, not the text); 'that with |Delta| > D, where D := M N1 T^{1-eps}, give a negligible <<_{A,eps} T^{-A} contribution' (the Delta-truncation D); 'Now we must study three cases: h = 0, |h| >= Hd := dM [N2-factor] T^{1-eps}' (the Hd line; fraction layout garbled in pdftotext); section 3.2.3: 'Let h Delta = a, A = D Hd / d = d^2 T^{1-eps}' (the A line, taken as the uniform bound A << d^2 T^{1-eps}; the exact Hd fraction is the only remaining verbatim gap).

THE BP PLUG POINT (confirmed at derivation level): S(v,n) = sum_{f in I/h, (f,dev)=1} mu^2(f) e(-n f/v) and its a-summed bilinear form over (a, f) with modulus v are EXACTLY the objects of Blomer-Pascadi Theorem 1.1 (all moduli, no factorization, no coprimality for full intervals). PR's bound = min(trivial, Weil-incomplete) via geometric mean; BP = strict improvement of the Weil leg (and of the trivial leg in the sub-trivial regime) in the critical range of lengths ~ v^{1/2}. The L1 substitution is termwise: replace the min-geometric-mean step by min(trivial, BP) - an improvement everywhere, strict near-critical.

FIRST-PASS BOUNDARY ARITHMETIC (A = d^2 T^{1-eps}, d ~ 1 worst case, block N1 N2 <= T^{1+o(1)}, N = T^theta): Type I term 1 = T^eps N1^{5/8} N2^{5/4} (A cancels in Type I; the d^{-33/8} d-sum converges), maximized at N2 = N, N1 = T^{1-theta}, gives T^{5/8 + 5theta/8} - admissible for theta < 3/5; Type I term 2 = T^eps N1 N2^{3/4} = T^{1-theta/4} - never binding; Type II monomials after division by d^3 A = d^3 T^{1-eps}: (0,4,4,2) -> T^{1-theta/2}; (-2,2,4,4) = (1,2,3,4) -> T^{3/8 + theta/8}; (-1,4,3,4) -> T^{3/16 + 3theta/4}; (3,2,3,3) -> T^{5/8 - 3theta/8}; (1,4,3,3) -> T^{7/8 + theta/8} - all below T for theta <= 1. At the boundary theta = 4/7 specifically, everything lands at or below N^{55/32} < N^{56/32}. FIRST-PASS CONCLUSION: my reconstruction's binding leg is Type I term 1 with TRUE THRESHOLD theta < 3/5, STRICTLY LARGER than the stated 4/7 - which is EXACTLY the threshold of the quoted clean error form T^eps(N^{7/4} + T^{1/2}N^{7/8}) (both legs hit T at theta = 4/7: 7*(4/7)/4 = 1 and 1/2 + 7*(4/7)/8 = 1). TWO HONEST READS: (B1) the reconstruction drops a factor - most plausibly the (n,v)^{1/2} of the Type I inner bound surviving the a-v-e summation, an hd-dependent d-power, or A larger than d^2 T^{1-eps} in some regime - and the true Conrey threshold is really 4/7; (B2) the true Conrey threshold is 3/5 (or in between) and the published 4/7 is a conservative clean statement - a genuine unpublished margin. NOTE: if the (n,v) factor survived as an extra V^{1/8} on term 1, its threshold would be theta < 1/4 - too strong to be the 4/7 wall, so under (B1) the missing factor must act on a different leg; the discriminator is the verbatim Hd/A fractions (pages 13-14) plus the line-by-line 'On summing over a, v, and e' step (pages 17-18). That page-level re-derivation is the exact next move, and it must precede any BP-substitution claim.
